plans.title: Fighting the Good Fight
plans.theme: Standing firm in faith, endurance, and spiritual warfare.

days.focus: Flee, Pursue, Fight — What it means to actively pursue righteousness.
Put on the Armor — Preparing yourself for spiritual battle.
Finish the Race — Remaining faithful to the end.
Enduring Trials — How God uses trials to build perseverance.
Run With Patience — Keeping your eyes on Christ when you want to quit.
God Is Merciful — His compassion, forgiveness, and patience.
God Is Holy — Seeing God rightly changes how we see ourselves.
God Is Gracious — His mercy and faithfulness toward His people.
God Knows You — Nothing about you is hidden from Him.
God Loves You — Nothing can separate the believer from God's love.

plans.title: The Gospel: Sin, Salvation & Grace
plans.theme: Understanding why we need the Gospel and what Christ accomplished.

days.focus: Our Sin — Every person is guilty before God.
Our Condition — We were spiritually dead, but God made us alive.
The New Birth — What it means to be born again.
Christ Died for Us — God's love demonstrated through Christ's death.
Made New — The believer becomes a new creation and receives reconciliation.

plans.title: Wisdom for Everyday Life
plans.theme: Learning to live wisely according to God's Word.

days.focus: Trust God — Trusting Him instead of leaning on your own understanding.
Guard Your Heart — What you allow into your heart affects your life.
Control Your Tongue — The incredible power of our words.
Our Plans, God's Direction — Making plans while submitting them to God.
Build on the Rock — Hearing God's Word isn't enough; we must obey it.

plans.title: Walking With Christ
plans.theme: What daily discipleship actually looks like.

days.focus: Deny Yourself — Taking up your cross and following Christ.
Abide in Christ — Staying connected to Christ and bearing fruit.
Walk by the Spirit — Putting the flesh to death and producing spiritual fruit.
Have the Mind of Christ — Humility, obedience, and serving others.
Put Off, Put On — Removing the old life and putting on the character of Christ.
